sentences.text: Melitosaurus was a gavialid crocodylian, a group of crocodiles known for their long snouts.
The fossil was discovered in 1850 in marine limestone in Gozo, Malta, and the genus was named by Owen that same year.
It belongs to the family Gavialidae and is a member of the subfamily Tomistominae, related to the living False gharial.
This animal lived during the Early Miocene Aquitanian stage, between 20.45 and 15.98 million years ago.
